 The Social Security Administration confirmed the payment schedule for November 2026.
 + Add El Cronista on abre en nueva pestaña By   Magalí Schefer 
 Translated and edited by   El Cronista EN Published on November 8, 2026 7:51 PM abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña abre en nueva pestaña En esta noticia Who gets retirement payments first in November 2026 
 What are the other two retirement payment dates in November? 
 What to do if the retirement deposit does not arrive on time 
 Who does not receive retirement payments based on their birth date 
 The U.S. government , through the Social Security Administration (SSA) , will distribute November 2026 retirement and pension payments on three different days. 
 Who gets retirement payments first in November 2026
 The first deposit will arrive on Tuesday, Nov. 10 , and will go to beneficiaries whose birthdays fall between the 1st and 10th of any month and who began receiving benefits after April 30, 1997. 
 The early payment is due to Veterans Day, observed Wednesday, Nov. 11 , a federal holiday that changes the usual distribution date.
 What are the other two retirement payment dates in November?
 The SSA’s official schedule sets out two other payment dates for beneficiaries who do not get paid on Tuesday, Nov. 10:
 Wednesday, Nov. 18: people born between the 11th and 20th. 
 Wednesday, Nov. 25: people born between the 21st and 31st. 
 What to do if the retirement deposit does not arrive on time
 The SSA recommends: “If you do not receive your payment on the expected date, please wait three additional mailing days before contacting Social Security” . 
 Who does not receive retirement payments based on their birth date
 People who were receiving Social Security benefits before May 1997 and those who receive Social Security and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) at the same time follow a different schedule.
 According to the SSA, Social Security was paid on Tuesday, Nov. 3, and SSI was paid last Friday, Oct. 30 , since Nov. 1 fell on a Sunday.
